name: Garnier Men Turbo Bright Anti-Pollution 40gm Brightening Moisturizer | India
description:
Garnier Men Turbo Bright Anti-Pollution 40gm Brightening Moisturizer | India 
BEATS DUST AND POLLUTION: Enriched with green tea extracts, lemon, and black charcoal, Garnier Turbo Bright Anti-Pollution Brightening Moisturiser efficiently beats dust and pollution to moisturise the skin. 
REDUCES DARK SPOTS AND UNEVEN SKIN TONE: Those who are struggling with dark spots and uneven skin tone can alleviate these issues by using the Garnier Turbo Bright Anti-Pollution Brightening Moisturiser. 
GIVES UV PROTECTION: This moisturizer from Garnier contains UV filters that help to protect the skin from harmful UV rays and sun damage. 
LIGHTWEIGHT FORMULA: The Garnier Turbo Bright Anti-Pollution Brightening Moisturiser has a lightweight texture that easily blends with the skin without leaving any traces. 
BRIGHTENS SKIN: The Garnier Turbo Bright Anti-Pollution Brightening Moisturiser removes dullness and paves way for brighter skin.
